title: 第30章 谢大师寿宴！
novel_title: 从暮年娶妻到长生不死
content_zh:
这些天，依旧在戮妖大祭期间。

    符石需求激增，但市场涨价不多。

    整体趋于稳定。

    每枚符石涨价不过五金到十金不等，沈云五枚符石换回来十五枚源石。

    这十五枚制作完成，沈云不打算全部卖了，而是留下几枚防身。

    这几日，圣城内不时有妖族被发现。

    每次都是一阵骚乱。

    最严重的是城中心，一位大妖暴露出真身，危及数千人死伤惨重。

    圣城内虽然说是安全区，但着不是游戏，任何地方都没有绝对的安全。

    圣城很大，灵农坊这边还算平静。

    夜里躺在庭院摇椅上，沈云和婉儿赏着星空三轮明月。

    品着买来的凝神灵茶，呼吸法在体内自行运转，炼化着血元丹。

    舒服~

    “传闻一轮明月上有我人族神朝，那里人族独尊，百姓生活安居乐业，蛮兽妖兽皆是碗中食。”

    沈云想起这段时间在杂谈上看到的一则传说。

    苏婉儿也向往说道，“我小时后也听过，一轮明月住着广寒天女，一轮明月栖居着真龙，最大最遥远的那月亮有人族仙国。”

    两人聊着听过看过的各种传闻异事，沈云心中无尽遐思。

    前世传说只是编撰的故事，今生的世界，这些传说很有可能是现实。

    不知那人道仙朝是何等景象，也不知广寒天女有多漂亮。

    走出秘境，去往更大世界的想法，悄悄在心中生根发芽。

    “沈老头一家倒是自在。”

    巷子中有人路过这里，看到这一幕，略带羡慕道。

    同行的人嗤笑一声开口，“一个修行无望等死的老头，一个凡俗女子。

    现在贪图享乐，十几年后不过冢中枯骨，容颜凋零，有什么值得羡慕？”

    养体二重的沈云耳聪目明，在夜风中捕获到了只言片语。

    打眼看去，是卫家的几个小崽子。

    沈云轻笑摇头，倒是随他们的父亲。

    这大抵是街坊邻居眼中他的形象，倒是符合他现如今低调发育的局面。

    一个时辰后，待到体内血元丹消化完毕，沈云又服下一枚。

    此中乐，不足为外人道也。

    ....

    次日，早早巡视完灵田。

    沈云，刘老和林巧娘等一群人结伴同行，去参加谢大师的寿宴典礼。

    宋达虽然不是守田人，但租了下品灵田耕种。

    他本来要去的，但是前段时间受的伤还没好，不宜前去祝寿。
content_en:
These days, it is still during the Demon Slaying Festival.

    The demand for rune stones has surged, but the market price has not increased much.

    The overall situation tends to be stable.

    The price of each runestone increased by only five gold to ten gold. Shen Yun exchanged five runestones for fifteen source stones.

    After these fifteen pieces were made, Shen Yun did not plan to sell them all, but kept a few for self-defense.

    In the past few days, monsters have been spotted in the Holy City from time to time.

    Each time there was a commotion.

    The most serious thing was in the center of the city, where a great demon revealed his true identity, threatening thousands of people with heavy casualties.

    Although the Holy City is said to be a safe zone, it is not a game. There is no absolute safety anywhere.

    The Holy City is very big, and the Lingnongfang side is quite peaceful.

    Lying on rocking chairs in the courtyard at night, Shen Yun and Wan'er admired the stars and the three bright moons.

    While sipping the purchased Ning Shen Shen Tea, the breathing method circulates in the body on its own, refining the Blood Essence Pill.

    Comfortable~

    "It is said that there is a divine dynasty of our human race on the bright moon, where the human race is the only one, the people live and work in peace and contentment, and all the wild beasts and monsters are food in the bowl."

    Chen Yun thought of a legend he saw on Zatan during this period.

    Su Waner also said yearningly, "I heard it when I was a child. A bright moon is inhabited by the goddess Guanghan, a bright moon is inhabited by a true dragon, and the largest and most distant moon is a human fairyland."

    The two chatted about the various rumors and strange things they had heard and seen, and Shen Yun had endless reveries in his heart.

    The legends of past lives are just made-up stories. In this world, these legends are very likely to be reality.

    I don’t know what the human immortal dynasty is like, and I don’t know how beautiful the goddess Guanghan is.

    The idea of ​​​​walking out of the secret realm and going to the larger world quietly took root in my heart.

    "Old Shen's family is quite at ease."

    Someone passing by in the alley saw this scene and said with a little envy.

    The person walking with him sneered and said, "An old man who has no hope of practicing and waiting to die, and an ordinary woman.

    If you are greedy for pleasure now, you will be nothing more than dry bones in the grave and your face will be withered in a dozen years. What is there to envy? "

    Shen Yun, who had gained the second level of body cultivation, had sharp ears and eyes, and he caught a few words in the night wind.

    At a glance, they were a few brats from the Wei family.

    Chen Yun chuckled and shook his head, following their father.

    This is probably his image in the eyes of his neighbors, which is in line with his current low-key development.

    An hour later, when the Blood Yuan Dan in his body was completely digested, Chen Yun took another one.

    The joy in this is not enough for outsiders to understand.

    ....

    The next day, we finished our inspection of the spiritual field early.

    A group of people including Shen Yun, Mr. Liu and Lin Qiaoniang went together to attend Master Xie's birthday banquet ceremony.

    Although Song Da was not a landkeeper, he rented a low-grade spiritual field for farming.

    He was going to go, but the injury he suffered some time ago has not healed yet, so it was not appropriate to go to celebrate his birthday.
title_en: Chapter 30 Thank you Master for the birthday banquet!
